nom: TULA The Rich Rinse Nourishing Cream Cleanser

avis.texte: I am OBSESSED! I recieved a sample for this product with a purchase I made on ULTA. I used it for the first time tonight and I am already a huge fan! For one, it smelled delightful. It went on smooth and felt nice on my face. After rinsing it off, I noticed an immediate difference. I have sensitive skin that doesn't take too well to most products so I am shocked! Maybe I'm jumping the gun and need to wait until the morning, but I am so in love with the way my dry skin is feeling right now - not dry at all! I will be repurchasing asap!
Very creamy and I love the moisture but does it rinse off as easily as the cult classic
Really like this product. Very gentle washing! Prefer it to the regular wash.

I really like this face wash. It lathers nicely and is very gentle. My skin feels nice and clean without being dry. I like that it doesnt have a strong scent. I was pleasantly surprised with how much I like this. I wasnnt expecting to like anything besides the cult classic.

My face feels softer than it has in a long time!! I love the soapy texture. Ive used channel wash similar in the past and this is so much better! My face feels so incredible!! I would recommend this to anyone looking for a great daily face wash.
I love this product!! I am turning 70 and I am fighting dry skin which leads to wrinkles. Leaves skin super hydrated. It removes all the day off your skin-products and makeup. Highly recommend!

While I was a fan of the original Tula cleanser, my skin is loving the extra moisture after this cleaning! I have dryer skin regularly so this additional touch of hydration does my skin good! Paired with the Tula Intense Moisturizer, my skin tackled the chilly and dry winter weather wonderfully.
The texture of this product is amazing! It feels so light and airy when applying. I also enjoy the light scent. It did not dry out my face after use which for me is a huge win. Definitely recommend!
Rich and creamy cleanser leaves my sensitive skin feeling clean and smooth. Definitely recommend
The rich rinse leaves my face feeling so clean and refreshed without striping away any of my faces natural moisture!

The rich rinse pairs perfectly with the moisture intense moisturizer. I have some concerns with my skin turning from oily combination to dry. Upon first use of the rich rinse, you can feel how hydrating it is. It left my skin feeling hydrated and clean.

This cleansers silky suds gently remove all that dull a complexion. My elderly dry skin feels fresh and soft after use! There is no need for fragrance or rough scrubbing with this gentle, effective cleanser. Its a winner!!

I have been a habitual user of the cult classic cleanser, which I absolutely love. I gave the new rich rinse a try for over a week. I really enjoy the rich lather that feels moisturizing and soothing. The downside is that it has a very putrid scent when applying to my face. If I could have this rich lather with the scent of the cult classic or scentless it would be a perfect product!

The Rich Rinse has been the perfect addition to my winter skincare routine. My skin is naturally dry and gets even drier during the cold, snowy months, so Im always looking for products that hydrate. This leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth and hydrated. Ive been using it with the 24-7 Moisture Intense Ultra Hydrating Day & Night Cream, and the combination has been amazing for keeping my skin moisturized all day.

avis.titre: Hate the smell but works so well
avis.texte: I cant stand the way this smells but I love the texture and how well it works! I live in a very dry climate and this helps keep my face from drying out.
Love the rich lather. Seems moisturizing. Wish it was unscented or smelled better.

My mature, stressed, winter skin needed something more than Cult Classic. From the first use of Rich Rinse, my tired skin had perked up, was soft and felt more hydrated. After two weeks of use, skin looks hydrated, feels more supple and rejuvenated. Adding to my skincare routine going forward!

I love this product! The Rich Rinse removes makeup effortlessly, without the harshness, and it leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and moisturized. I love the silky texture and the smooth foaming action. My face is sensitive to fragrant products, so I love this mild formula that still has a pleasant smell and a smooth finish.
This product is top notch! It has a wonderful creamy consistency that feels amazing on your face. It leaves your skin feeling clean, prepped and ready for toners, serums and moisturizer.

avis.titre: Cleans skin without feeling stripped, great texture!
avis.texte: Im 42 with combination & somewhat sensitive skin and the Tula product line works extremely well for me. After using the Rich Rinse for a few weeks, I have found it does a great job of cleansing skin and removing makeup in a single wash. It lathers nicely and feels great on my face. I love that my skin feels nourished and not stripped after washing with this product - but it doesnt feel like there‚Äôs a residue, just clean, hydrated skin. The thick & creamy texture means the product doesnt slip or slide around. Would definitely recommend this, especially if you struggle with dryness in the winter.

this is a nice gentle cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean but not stripped (dry and flaky). skin feels moisurized and soft after using. I generally prefer unscented face cleaners and this product does have a strong scent (pleasant but strong nonetheless)

So far Im loving this product. Most other face washes leave my skin feeling too dry, and since I regularly use both the Tula 24-7 Ultra Hydration serum and 24-7 Moisture Intense day & night cream for my dry, acne prone skin so I am so glad they have added a face wash to this line! It feels rich and creamy going on and after rinsing off my skin is not tight like with many other face washes, and my face actually feels clean after using it. I definitely recommend trying this product if you need a gentle but effective face wash!
Beautiful creamy texture foams Nicely and leave my skin feeling clean and refreshed

The rich rinse definitely exceeded my expectations! Does not dry out but doesnt make your skin oily either, it washes off immediately. I like to apply it to my skin when dry, rub a bit and then add water. Washes off so nicely. No residue. No dry skin. Just perfect. BTW my skin is oily combination and it works amazingly !!!!

I‚Äôve been using The Rich Rinse for several days. Its creamy and removes all of my makeup. Leaves my skin clean and soft and ready for my Tula 24/7 intense moisture hydration cream. Thank you for sending me the Rich Rinse to try. Ill be purchasing it in the future.

Best moisturizer I have tried! Thoroughly washes and cleanses your face. BUT with an add bonus of hydration and moisture for your skin. An incredible add to your skincare routine- especially in the dry winter months!

The new face wash offers a great cleansing experience, but the scent does not work well for me. It is overpowering to the point that I dont care to use it. I'm keeping it in my downstairs bathroom for times when I want to wash my face, but going upstairs is not practical. I cant really identify the scent, but it is not a citrus or floral scent. It is somewhat fruity, but in a very artificial and overpowering way.

The new face wash was so easy to use. It can be applied to dry or damp skin, making it convenient to use both in and out of the shower. I love the texture and it went on easy and felt nice on my skin and was easy to remove. I gave it 3 stars because I dont like the smell and that was a major deterrent to continue to use since its so close to my nose.

Ok I am loving this new cleanser!! The scent is light and neutral and a little goes a long way. The Rich Rinse Cleanser is similar to my favorite the Cult Classic Cleanser in how well it removes makeup and cleanses my skin, but because of its creamier texture, it leaves my skin feeling more hydrated and not tight which is perfect for colder months. Ill keep using Rich Rinse in the winter when my dry skin needs more moisture and Cult Classic in the warmer seasons. Both will continue to be staples in my routine!
I love this new face wash. Its creamy and light but gets the job done. My skin is so soft after using it. All my make-up is removed easily. Even the waterproof brow gel and mascara.

I have been a longstanding user of the cult classic wash but was excited to give this one a try. It has such a luxurious feel and lather, and feels extra moisturizing. This has been essential given winter and cold air leaving my skin much drier than typical. I have been using this both in the AM and PM and have noticed my skin feeling softer and less tight. I have sensitive skin and have not experienced any redness or sensitivity using this wash!
I could not stand the smell. It had a disgusting smell attempted to be covered up by an obnoxious citrus smell. I ordered this thinking it was a cream version of the cult classic. Disappointing.
I've loved using this so far. It makes my skin feel really clean but not stripped or tight, but hydrated. It has a great lather and feel to the formula too. Would recommend!
The smell is horrible! Like everything about it but that smell is awful and lingers! I love every Tula item so was disappointed. Back to the Cult Classic cleanser.
LOVE this face wash! Doesnt dry my skin out & leaves my face feeling clean & nourished! Highly recommend
The new rich rinse is amazing! I love the scent and texture. I love how it makes my face feel! Tula has done it again another fabulous product!

I was nervous to switch from the cult classic cleanser because I have been using it forever and I absolutely love it. Since Ive switched over Ive noticed it leaves a really nice glow even before applying my toner and moisturizer. This is a perfect cleanser for the winter time if you live in a cooler climate. I feel like Im getting a deep clean while still keeping my face moisturized.

I like this new cream face cleanser as it is very similar to the Tula Cult Classic face cleanser that I have been using for a long time and love as well. This new creamy face cleanser is amazing and smells really good without irritating my sensitive face and skin at all in the shower just like the classic face cleanser I use daily.
Love this cleanser. It feels so comforting with how creamy it is and how smoothly it applies. You can feel the deep hydration happening even as your skin becomes squeaky clean!

In a houshold of two teen girls with SUPER dry skin, I was looking for something that was 1 non stripping but would take a way the make up and oil from their teen faces without stripping. 2 was economical because lets face it kids arent always the most careful in dispensing products at all time. 3 was a product I too could add to my routine, that wasnt going to upset my somewhat sensitive skin. This product is just IT. It feels luxurious on the skin with its soft creamy texture. It hasn't upset anyones moisture barrier and the small amout of redness I have from using retinol has gone. Our skin feel super clean yet hydrated. Will definitely keep buying.

This is a great cleanser overall. Its very creamy but foams up nicely when mixed with water. I purposely skipped my makeup removing step before showering to see just how well this cleanser alone could remove stubborn makeup. I did have to double cleanse but it took it all off! It also didnt burn my eyes. The only downside is the scent. Its pretty strong! Its the exact same scent as the 24/7 intense moisturizer. I really dont like fragrance in my skincare products, so I really hope Tula comes out with a fragrance free version of this cleanser like the cult classic.

I must say I love love this cleanser! It is wonderfully creamy and works so well on my skin - I'm 59 and I find this to be really nourishing. A little goes a long way so I feel like this tube will last a while, which makes it even more worth the price! I've loved the cult classic for a while now, but I think I prefer the creamy texture of the rich rinse. They are definitely the best two cleansers on the market. I think it would be whether or not you prefer gel vs. cream. Thank you, Tula for giving us such great options!

I've really enjoyed the Rich Rinse so far! It feels softer on my face than other face washes I've used and like it's stripping my skin less. I live in WY, so winters are incredibly cold, dry and irritating to my skin. I really like how this helps clean my skin, but doesn't irritate it more.

I started using the new rich rinse last week and I can already see such a difference in my skin! You get a very nourishing feel to your skin after using, my skin feels so good, and not tight at all. The texture of the product makes it feel like I am at a spa! The creamy to foam created such a nice lather that is so luxurious. Would recommend!

The only reason I didnt give this 5 stars is because Im not the biggest fan of the scent, other than that I really love this cleanser! Especially in the winter months when everything is so dry I felt like not only was my skin super clean but also felt hydrated after washing. I also love the amount of lather it produced for being a cream cleanser and that it removes makeup in a gentle manner. Would definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a hydrating cleanser that leaves your skin looking super refreshed and smooth!

rich rinse is right on performance wise! i did my post sweat PM double cleanse using just the rich rinse and no traces of the day remained when i was finished. my skin felt balanced and hydrated, not stripped and tight. i was pleasantly surprised by the luxe feeling creamier foam texture that lathered nicely once introduced to water. i did remove a star for ingredient related reasons - i dont love a cleanser with an added fragrance. im very sensitive to smells and wish there was a fragrance free option (like cult classic). overall, i like this cleanser and will be introducing to my routine a few nights a week when i need a deeper clean.

I have combination and sensitive skin so finding a cleanser that actually works for me is always a challenge but I was pleasantly surprised by Rich Rinse. I've previously used TULAs cult classic and while I liked it overall, it always burned my eyes which was a big downside for me. Rich Rinse has been a totally different experience so far! It's been a couple weeks without any eye irritation or sensitivity issues at all. It feels creamy and gentle while still cleansing well, and my skin feels clean and balanced after using it. Plus it has a really neutral, pleasant smell. My complexion has been looking really good since I started using it, and thankfully no dryness or flare-ups. This has easily become a new favorite in my routine, though I use minimal makeup but I'd recommend especially for anyone with sensitive skin who still wants an effective cleanse.

Loving the Rich Rinse. Its a bit thick (in a good way) and gentle and leaves my face feeling clean without that right, dry feeling. It removes makeup easily and leaves my skin feels soft and hydrated!

I really enjoyed this new cleanser, from the start when you first apply it goes on very smooth. It doesn't dry me out at all but I always follow up with my favorite 24-7 moisturizer. It's my new go to cleanser.

Ive really enjoyed my first few uses with The Rich Rinse! I was sent it from Tula and its really helped with my dry winter skin with how cold its been! It feels really luxurious and my skin doesnt feel tight after using. Thank you Tula!
